# Standard

This folder contains documentation on the strict clinical performance targets, quality thresholds, and regulatory goals applied to medical indicators within the Akut Kirurgi Databasen (Acute Surgery Database). It covers the entire patient journey, detailing specific percentage standards for pre-operative timeliness (such as antibiotic administration and CT scans), post-operative recovery metrics, and strict upper limits for 30-day and 90-day mortality rates. Additionally, it outlines the supplementary "development goals" designed to push hospital departments beyond baseline regulatory requirements to drive continuous quality improvement in acute surgical care.

## Pages

- [[standard|Standard]] — Details the specific percentage thresholds, mortality limits, and continuous development goals applied to acute surgery indicators across pre-operative, post-operative, and survival metrics.
